title: Your Board Doesn't Understand Their Role (Yet)
actionable_recommendations: Conduct a board self-assessment using a short questionnaire.
Create a board matrix to identify skills and gaps.
Develop board member profiles for recruitment based on identified gaps.
Onboard new board members with a clear orientation package that includes mission, roles, and responsibilities.
Incorporate micro training sessions in regular meetings to build skills.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Successful board development can significantly impact an organization's success.
Every board member has a duty of care to secure resources for the organization.
Personal donations by board members send a strong message to donors.
intended_organization_or_user: Nonprofits looking to improve board effectiveness and fundraising capabilities.
major_ideas: Importance of board development in small nonprofits.
Conducting assessments to identify board member engagement and skills.
Recruiting strategically to fill gaps in skills and diversity.
Effective onboarding processes for new board members.
Utilizing micro training to enhance board competence.
prerequisites: Understanding of the nonprofit's mission and programs.
Knowledge of the roles and responsibilities within the board.
proposed_workflow: Conduct a self-assessment of the current board.
Create a board matrix to visualize skills and gaps.
Develop profiles for new board members based on identified needs.
Recruit new members through existing networks and professional associations.
Onboard new members with a comprehensive orientation package.
tools_templates_resources: Orientation package for new board members.
Free online resources for micro training.
